claims.statement: Every finite action-indexed relation process at a fixed finite horizon admits a finite family of deterministic counterfactual master trees whose wordwise visible target supports equal the raw relational supports exactly.

Every finite total rational action-indexed stochastic kernel process at a fixed finite horizon admits one policy-independent rational measure on deterministic counterfactual masters reproducing every literal action-word law exactly.
The same ex-ante master measure reproduces the exact visible history law of every deterministic adaptive policy that chooses actions from visible history.

Any finite operational model class closed under the corresponding hidden counterfactual-master extension cannot operationally distinguish online generation from ex-ante pre-sampling in that declared finite-horizon language; falsifiability therefore requires an additional latent-extension-nonclosure admissibility axiom.
